results.content:
{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output": "# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Runtime & Deployment

- **Entrypoint**: `bin/serve` prepares SQLite (`bin/rails db:prepare`), compiles Propshaft assets (`bin/rails assets:clobber assets:precompile`), and runs Puma in the foreground listening on `0.0.0.0:${PORT}`.
- **Plain HTTP & Host Independence**: `config.assume_ssl = false`, `config.force_ssl = false`, `config.hosts.clear`, `config.public_file_server.enabled = true`, and ActionCable's `allow_same_origin_as_host = true` ensure the app works over plain HTTP on any conference network hostname without external dependencies.
- **Storage & Concurrency**: All persistent state lives under `storage/` (`storage/production.sqlite3`, WAL mode with `foreign_keys = ON`). `config/database.yml` sizes `max_connections` to `RAILS_MAX_THREADS + 10` so Puma threads (`5`) and ActionCable worker pool threads never starve under conference load.
- **Health Check**: `GET /up` returns `200` without authentication.

## Authentication & Authorization

- All moderator routes live under `/moderate` and inherit from `Moderate::BaseController`.
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic Authentication comparing against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` and `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD"]` using SHA-256 digests with `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`. Empty credentials are always rejected (`401`).
- Public player routes (`/play/:code`, `/play/:code/join`, `/play/:code/answer`, `/play/:code/state`) inherit directly from `ApplicationController` and require no account or moderator credentials.
- ActionCable channels authorize per-channel via Rails `ActiveRecord::SignedId` tokens with distinct purposes (`:moderator_channel` on `Game`, `:player_channel` on `Player`) so players cannot subscribe to moderator streams or other players' streams.

## Data Model

### Quiz Authoring
- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required, whitespace-normalized). `has_many :games, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :questions, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy`.
- `Question` (`questions`): `quiz_id`, `body`, `position`, `active` (default `true`). `has_many :options, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :game_questions, dependent: :nullify`.
- `Option` (`options`): `question_id`, `title`, `correct` (default `false`), `position`.
- `Question#save_with_options` validates `body` and non-empty option rows (>= 2 options, >= 1 correct) before touching the DB.
- `Question#move!(direction)` atomically swaps adjacent positions and normalizes `1..N`.

### Live Games (Snapshotted per Run)
- `Game` (`games`): `quiz_id`, `code` (unique 5-char uppercase unambiguous code, e.g. `K7RZX`), `status` (`lobby` -> `question` -> `reveal` -> `ended`), `current_question_position`, `started_at`, `ended_at`.
  - `Game.create_for_quiz!(quiz)` snapshots only active questions (in position order) into `GameQuestion` and their options into `GameOption`. Inactive questions are skipped, and later edits/deletes on `Question`/`Option` never break or corrupt past/running games.
  - State transitions (`start!`, `finish_question!`, `next_question!`, `end_game!`) use atomic conditional `update_all` guards (with optional `expected_position`) inside transactions so accidental double-clicks cannot skip questions.
- `GameQuestion` (`game_questions`): `game_id`, `question_id` (nullable, `on_delete: :nullify`), `body`, `position`.
- `GameOption` (`game_options`): `game_question_id`, `title`, `correct`, `position`.
- `Player` (`players`): `game_id`, `name` (whitespace-normalized, duplicate names allowed), `token` (unique random token persisted in a per-game signed HttpOnly cookie `quizzy_player_#{code}` so reopening the join link in the same browser continues as the same player).
- `Answer` (`answers`): `game_id`, `player_id`, `game_question_id`, `game_option_id`, unique index on `[player_id, game_question_id]`. `Game#record_answer!` uses `Answer.upsert` so players can change their pick while a question is open and the last pick counts; submissions after `"Finish"` are rejected with `409` and return the authoritative server state.

### Security Invariant (Answer Confidentiality)
- `Game#player_broadcast_state` and `Game#player_state` strictly omit `correct` flags while `status` is `"lobby"` or `"question"`, and only expose the current question's options (never upcoming questions). Neither the initial HTML source, JSON state endpoint, nor WebSocket frames reveal correct answers before `"Finish"`.

## Real-Time Updates, Presence & Conference Wi-Fi Resilience

- **Transport**: ActionCable (`adapter: async` in single-process Puma, `actioncable.esm.js` vendored offline via Importmap) with three channels:
  - `ModeratorGameChannel`: streams `game:#{id}:moderator` (`state`, `presence`, `counts`) and immediately transmits full `moderator_state` on subscribe/reconnect.
  - `PlayerGameChannel`: streams `game:#{id}:players` (shared phase transitions without thundering-herd HTTP refetches on reveal) and `game:#{id}:player:#{player.id}` (cross-tab answer sync), and transmits personalized `player_state` on subscribe/reconnect.
  - `JoinStatusChannel`: lightweight stream on unjoined join pages so they live-switch to `"The quiz is over"` if the game ends before the visitor submits, without counting them as players.
- **Live Presence (`GamePresence`)**:
  - Thread-safe in-memory registry tracking `{ game_id => { player_id => { tab_id => expires_at } } }`.
  - Deduplicates multiple tabs in the same browser under one `player_id`.
  - Decrements immediately on tab close / navigation (`unsubscribed` + `pagehide` disconnect), and evicts silently dropped Wi-Fi connections via client heartbeats (`4s`) and a background reaper (`15s` staleness timeout) with zero DB writes.
- **Flaky Wi-Fi Recovery**:

cat <<'EOF' > docs/architecture.md
# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Runtime & Deployment

- **Entrypoint**: `bin/serve` prepares SQLite (`bin/rails db:prepare`), compiles Propshaft assets (`bin/rails assets:clobber assets:precompile`), and runs Puma in the foreground listening on `0.0.0.0:${PORT}`.
- **Plain HTTP & Host Independence**: `config.assume_ssl = false`, `config.force_ssl = false`, `config.hosts.clear`, `config.public_file_server.enabled = true`, and ActionCable's `allow_same_origin_as_host = true` ensure the app works over plain HTTP on any conference network hostname without external dependencies.
- **Storage & Concurrency**: All persistent state lives under `storage/` (`storage/production.sqlite3`, WAL mode with `foreign_keys = ON`). `config/database.yml` sizes `max_connections` to `RAILS_MAX_THREADS + 10` so Puma threads (`5`) and ActionCable worker pool threads never starve under conference load.
- **Health Check**: `GET /up` returns `200` without authentication.

## Authentication & Authorization

- All moderator routes live under `/moderate` and inherit from `Moderate::BaseController`.
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic Authentication comparing against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` and `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD"]` using SHA-256 digests with `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`. Empty credentials are always rejected (`401`).
- Public player routes (`/play/:code`, `/play/:code/join`, `/play/:code/answer`, `/play/:code/state`) inherit directly from `ApplicationController` and require no account or moderator credentials.
- ActionCable channels authorize per-channel via Rails `ActiveRecord::SignedId` tokens with distinct purposes (`:moderator_channel` on `Game`, `:player_channel` on `Player`) so players cannot subscribe to moderator streams or other players' streams.

## Data Model

### Quiz Authoring
- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required, whitespace-normalized), `number_of_winners` (integer, default `3`, must be `>= 1`). `has_many :games, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :questions, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy`.
- `Question` (`questions`): `quiz_id`, `body`, `position`, `active` (default `true`). `has_many :options, dependent: :destroy`, `has_many :game_questions, dependent: :nullify`.
- `Option` (`options`): `question_id`, `title`, `correct` (default `false`), `position`.
- `Question#save_with_options` validates `body` and non-empty option rows (>= 2 options, >= 1 correct) before touching the DB.
- `Question#move!(direction)` atomically swaps adjacent positions and normalizes `1..N`.

### Live Games (Snapshotted per Run)
- `Game` (`games`): `quiz_id`, `code` (unique 5-char uppercase unambiguous code, e.g. `K7RZX`), `status` (`lobby` -> `question` -> `reveal` -> `ended`), `current_question_position`, `started_at`, `ended_at`, `state_version` (monotonically incremented on every phase/winner transition to prevent stale out-of-order client state overwrites).
  - `Game.create_for_quiz!(quiz)` snapshots only active questions (in position order) into `GameQuestion` and their options into `GameOption`. Inactive questions are skipped, and later edits/deletes on `Question`/`Option` never break or corrupt past/running games.
  - State transitions (`start!`, `finish_question!`, `next_question!`, `end_game!`) use atomic conditional `update_all` guards (with optional `expected_position`) inside transactions so accidental double-clicks cannot skip questions.
- `GameQuestion` (`game_questions`): `game_id`, `question_id` (nullable, `on_delete: :nullify`), `body`, `position`, `opened_at` (set atomically when `start!` or `next_question!` opens that question).
- `GameOption` (`game_options`): `game_question_id`, `title`, `correct`, `position`.
- `Player` (`players`): `game_id`, `name` (whitespace-normalized, duplicate names allowed), `token` (unique random token persisted in a per-game signed HttpOnly cookie `quizzy_player_#{code}` so reopening the join link in the same browser continues as the same player), `winner` (boolean, default `false`).
- `Answer` (`answers`): `game_id`, `player_id`, `game_question_id`, `game_option_id`, `response_time_us` (exact microseconds from `game_question.opened_at` to the player's last pick), unique index on `[player_id, game_question_id]`. `Game#record_answer!` uses `Answer.upsert` so changing a pick updates both `game_option_id` and `response_time_us`, while an identical retry of the already-saved option preserves the original timestamp; submissions after `"Finish"` are rejected with `409` and return the authoritative server state.

### Scoring, Leaderboard & Winner Picking
- **Scoring & Ranking (`Game#leaderboard`)**:
  - 1 point per correct answer (aggregated in SQL over `answers JOIN game_options WHERE correct = true`).
  - Equal points are broken by lower total `response_time_us` of **correct answers only** (wrong answers do not contribute to speed total), with deterministic `(created_at, player_id)` fallback.
  - Players never see points, places, or winner status during `lobby`, `question`, or `reveal`.
- **Picking Winners (`POST /moderate/games/:id/{top_winners,draw_winners,reset_winners}`)**:
  - **Top N (`pick_top_winners!`)**: picks the first `N` (`quiz.number_of_winners`) players with `points > 0` in leaderboard order.
  - **Draw (`draw_winners!`)**: among players with `points > 0`, if `eligible.size <= N` all eligible players win; otherwise every player with `points > cutoff_points` (where `cutoff_points` is the N-th place's points) wins automatically, and the remaining `N - auto_winners.size` prizes are drawn uniformly at random (`Random.new`) among all players with `points == cutoff_points` (ignoring speed). Each click draws fresh winners.
  - **0-point exclusion**: players with `0 points` never win under either Top N or Draw.
  - **Reset (`reset_winners!`)**: clears `winner = false` on all players in the game.
  - All winner mutations persist `players.winner`, bump `state_version`, and broadcast live to `ModeratorGameChannel` and every player's personal `PlayerGameChannel` stream (`game:#{id}:player:#{player.id}`).

### Security Invariant (Answer & Score Confidentiality)
- `Game#player_broadcast_state` and `Game#player_state` strictly omit `correct` flags while `status` is `"lobby"` or `"question"`, strictly omit `points`/`place`/`total_players`/`winner` while `status` is not `"ended"`, and only expose the current question's options (never upcoming questions).

## Real-Time Updates, Presence & Conference Wi-Fi Resilience

- **Transport**: ActionCable (`adapter: async` in single-process Puma, `actioncable.esm.js` vendored offline via Importmap) with three channels:
  - `ModeratorGameChannel`: streams `game:#{id}:moderator` (`state`, `presence`, `counts`) and immediately transmits full `moderator_state` on subscribe/reconnect.
  - `PlayerGameChannel`: streams `game:#{id}:players` (single shared broadcast for instant simultaneous question delivery & reveal across all phones without thundering-herd HTTP refetches) and `game:#{id}:player:#{player.id}` (cross-tab answer sync + personalized ended results & live `"You won!"` winner updates), and transmits personalized `player_state` on subscribe/reconnect. Stays connected after `ended` (without presence heartbeats) so phones update live on `"Top N"`, `"Draw"`, and `"Reset winners"`, including after page reload.
  - `JoinStatusChannel`: lightweight stream on unjoined join pages so they live-switch to `"The quiz is over"` if the game ends before the visitor submits, without counting them as players.
- **Live Presence (`GamePresence`)**:
  - Thread-safe in-memory registry tracking `{ game_id => { player_id => { tab_id => expires_at } } }`.
  - Deduplicates multiple tabs in the same browser under one `player_id`.
  - Decrements immediately on tab close / navigation (`unsubscribed` + `pagehide` disconnect), and evicts silently dropped Wi-Fi connections via client heartbeats (`4s`) and a background reaper (`15s` staleness timeout) with zero DB writes. Cleared on `end_game!`.
- **Flaky Wi-Fi Recovery**:
  - Both `moderator_game_controller.js` and `player_game_controller.js` reconnect aggressively on `disconnected`, `online`, and `visibilitychange`, guard against stale `state_version` messages, and automatically fall back to HTTP JSON polling (`GET .../state`) only while WebSocket is disconnected (stopping as soon as WS recovers).
  - `player_game_controller.js` uses single-flight latest-wins answer submission with automatic retry on transient network failures so rapid taps never race out of order and Wi-Fi blips recover cleanly.
  - All live endpoints set `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- **QR Code**: Generated purely server-side as inline SVG via `rqrcode` (`ApplicationHelper#qr_code_svg`) with `#000000` modules, `#ffffff` background `<rect>`, 4-module quiet zone, and `xmlns` — zero external services.

## Quiz Export & Import

- **Export**: `GET /moderate/quizzes/:quiz_id/export` renders `Quiz#to_export_json` inside `<pre class="code-block">`. Strictly scoped to `title`, `questions`, and `options` — live games/players/answers are never exported.
- **Import**: `GET/POST /moderate/import` uses `QuizImport` to validate the full JSON payload before creating a new `Quiz` atomically (with default `number_of_winners = 3`).

## Notes for Future Releases (Past Games & Responses)

- `games`, `game_questions`, `game_options`, `players` (including persisted `winner`), and `answers` (including `response_time_us`) persist full per-game history needed for past-game listings and post-game per-question moderator response views.
- `quizzy.css` already includes `.runs-table`, `.badge`, and `.response-*` styles ready for future features.
EOF

require "net/http"
require "fileutils"
require "timeout"
require "base64"
require "ferrum"

port = 3199

  "PORT" => port.to_s,
  "SECRET_KEY_BASE" => "prod-smoke-test-secret-key-base-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME" => "prodmod",
  "QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD" => "prodpass"
}

# Remove any stale production sqlite before clean test
Dir.glob("storage/production.sqlite3*").each { |f| FileUtils.rm_f(f) }

pid = spawn(env, "bin/serve", out: "tmp/prod_smoke.log", err: "tmp/prod_smoke.log")
browsers = []

begin
  # Wait for GET /up -> 200
  Timeout.timeout(30) do
    loop do
      begin
        res = Net::HTTP.get_response(URI("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/up"))
        break if res.code == "200"
      rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED, Errno::ECONNRESET
      end
      sleep 0.25
    end
  end
  puts "OK: GET /up returned 200"

  # Check arbitrary Host header over plain HTTP (no HTTPS redirect)
  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new("/moderate")
  req["Host"] = "conference-wifi.example.internal:#{port}"
  req.basic_auth("prodmod", "prodpass")
  res = Net::HTTP.start("127.0.0.1", port) { |http| http.request(req) }
  raise "Expected 200 on arbitrary Host, got #{res.code}" unless res.code == "200"
  puts "OK: Arbitrary Host header over plain HTTP returned 200"

  # Launch 3 real Chromium contexts (moderator, alice, bob)
  browser_opts = {
    browser_path: "/usr/bin/chromium",
    headless: true,
    window_size: [1280, 900],
    browser_options: { "no-sandbox" => nil, "disable-dev-shm-usage" => nil },
    timeout: 15
  }
  mod = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  alice = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  bob = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  browsers.push(mod, alice, bob)

  auth_val = "Basic #{Base64.strict_encode64("prodmod:prodpass")}"
  mod.headers.set("Authorization" => auth_val)

  wait_for = lambda do |b, text, timeout: 5.0|
    deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + timeout
    loop do
      body = b.evaluate("document.body.innerText")
      return true if body.include?(text)
      raise "Timed out waiting for #{text.inspect} in:\n#{body}" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
      sleep 0.05
    end
  end

  wait_absent = lambda do |b, text, timeout: 5.0|
    deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + timeout
    loop do
      body = b.evaluate("document.body.innerText")
      return true unless body.include?(text)
      raise "Timed out waiting for absence of #{text.inspect} in:\n#{body}" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
      sleep 0.05
    end
  end

  # Create quiz with Number of winners = 1
  mod.go_to("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/moderate/quizzes/new")
  wait_for.call(mod, "Number of winners")
  default_n = mod.evaluate("document.querySelector('input[type=\"number\"]').value")
  raise "Expected default 3, got #{default_n}" unless default_n == "3"

  mod.at_css("input[name='quiz[title]']").focus.type("Prod Smoke Quiz")
  mod.evaluate("document.querySelector('input[name=\"quiz[number_of_winners]\"]').value = '1'")
  mod.at_css("input[type='submit']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Prod Smoke Quiz")

  # Add a question
  mod.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()='Add question']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Save question")
  mod.at_css("textarea[name='question[body]']").focus.type("Best conference quiz app?")
  mod.at_css("input[aria-label='Option 1']").focus.type("Quizzy")
  mod.at_css("input[aria-label='Option 1 is correct']").click
  mod.at_css("input[aria-label='Option 2']").focus.type("Other")
  mod.at_css("input[type='submit']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Best conference quiz app?")

  # Start a game
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Start a game']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Players: 0")
  join_url = mod.at_css(".lobby__url").text.strip
  puts "OK: Game created, join URL = #{join_url}"

  # Alice & Bob join

  wait_for.call(alice, "Your name")
  alice.at_css("#player_name").focus.type("Alice")
  alice.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Join']").click
  wait_for.call(alice, "Hi, Alice!")

  bob.go_to(join_url)
  wait_for.call(bob, "Your name")
  bob.at_css("#player_name").focus.type("Bob")
  bob.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Join']").click
  wait_for.call(bob, "Hi, Bob!")

  wait_for.call(mod, "Players: 2")

        res = Net::HTTP.get_response(URI("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/up"))
        break if res.code == "200"
      rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED, Errno::ECONNRESET
      end
      sleep 0.25
    end
  end
  puts "OK: GET /up returned 200"

  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new("/moderate")
  req["Host"] = "conference-wifi.example.internal:#{port}"
  req.basic_auth("prodmod", "prodpass")
  res = Net::HTTP.start("127.0.0.1", port) { |http| http.request(req) }
  raise "Expected 200 on arbitrary Host, got #{res.code}" unless res.code == "200"
  puts "OK: Arbitrary Host header over plain HTTP returned 200"

  browser_opts = {
    browser_path: "/usr/bin/chromium",
    headless: true,
    window_size: [1280, 900],
    browser_options: { "no-sandbox" => nil, "disable-dev-shm-usage" => nil },
    timeout: 15
  }
  mod = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  alice = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  bob = Ferrum::Browser.new(**browser_opts)
  browsers.push(mod, alice, bob)

  auth_val = "Basic #{Base64.strict_encode64("prodmod:prodpass")}"
  mod.headers.set("Authorization" => auth_val)

  wait_for = lambda do |b, text, timeout: 5.0|
    deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + timeout
    loop do
      body = b.evaluate("document.body.innerText")
      return true if body.include?(text)
      raise "Timed out waiting for #{text.inspect} in:\n#{body}" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
      sleep 0.02
    end
  end

  wait_absent = lambda do |b, text, timeout: 5.0|
    deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + timeout
    loop do
      body = b.evaluate("document.body.innerText")
      return true unless body.include?(text)
      raise "Timed out waiting for absence of #{text.inspect} in:\n#{body}" if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
      sleep 0.02
    end
  end

  # Create quiz with Number of winners = 1
  mod.go_to("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/moderate/quizzes/new")
  wait_for.call(mod, "Number of winners")
  default_n = mod.evaluate("document.querySelector('input[type=\"number\"]').value")
  raise "Expected default 3, got #{default_n}" unless default_n == "3"

  mod.at_css("input[name='quiz[title]']").focus.type("Prod Smoke Quiz")
  mod.evaluate("document.querySelector('input[name=\"quiz[number_of_winners]\"]').value = '1'")
  mod.at_css("input[type='submit']").scroll_into_view.click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Prod Smoke Quiz")

  # Add a question
  mod.at_xpath("//a[normalize-space()='Add question']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "New question")
  mod.at_css("textarea[name='question[body]']").focus.type("Best conference quiz app?")
  mod.at_css("#question_option_rows_0_title").focus.type("Quizzy")
  mod.at_css("#question_option_rows_0_correct").scroll_into_view.click
  mod.at_css("#question_option_rows_1_title").focus.type("Other")
  mod.at_css("input[type='submit']").scroll_into_view.click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Best conference quiz app?")

  # Start a game
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Start a game']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Players: 0")
  join_url = mod.at_css(".lobby__url").text.strip
  puts "OK: Game created, join URL = #{join_url}"

  # Alice & Bob join
  alice.go_to(join_url)
  wait_for.call(alice, "Your name")
  alice.at_css("#player_name").focus.type("Alice")
  alice.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Join']").click
  wait_for.call(alice, "Hi, Alice!")

  bob.go_to(join_url)
  wait_for.call(bob, "Your name")
  bob.at_css("#player_name").focus.type("Bob")
  bob.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Join']").click
  wait_for.call(bob, "Hi, Bob!")

  wait_for.call(mod, "Players: 2")
  puts "OK: Both players connected via production ActionCable WebSockets"

  # Click Start and measure live sync latency to both phones!
  t0 = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Start']").click
  wait_for.call(alice, "Best conference quiz app?")
  wait_for.call(bob, "Best conference quiz app?")
  sync_ms = ((Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t0) * 1000).round
  puts "OK: Both phones received Q1 live in #{sync_ms}ms!"
  raise "Sync too slow: #{sync_ms}ms" if sync_ms > 2000

  # Alice answers right faster than Bob
  alice.at_xpath("//button[contains(., 'Quizzy')]").click
  sleep 0.25
  bob.at_xpath("//button[contains(., 'Quizzy')]").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Answers: 2 / 2")

  # Finish -> End quiz
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Finish']").click
  wait_for.call(alice, "Correct!")
  wait_for.call(bob, "Correct!")
  raise "Points leaked during reveal!" if alice.evaluate("document.body.innerText").include?("point")

  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='End quiz']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Top 1")
  wait_for.call(alice, "Place 1 of 2")
  wait_for.call(alice, "1 point")
  wait_for.call(bob, "Place 2 of 2")
  wait_for.call(bob, "1 point")
  puts "OK: Leaderboard and phone placements updated LIVE!"

  # Top 1 -> Alice wins live, Bob does not
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Top 1']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Winner")
  wait_for.call(alice, "You won!")
  wait_absent.call(bob, "You won!")
  puts "OK: Top 1 updated leaderboard and phones LIVE!"

  # Reset winners -> Alice loses You won! live
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Reset winners']").click
  wait_absent.call(mod, "Winner")
  wait_absent.call(alice, "You won!")
  puts "OK: Reset winners updated leaderboard and phones LIVE!"

  # Draw -> 1 winner among Alice/Bob live
  mod.at_xpath("//button[normalize-space()='Draw']").click
  wait_for.call(mod, "Winner")
  sleep 0.15
  a_won = alice.evaluate("document.body.innerText").include?("You won!")
  b_won = bob.evaluate("document.body.innerText").include?("You won!")
  raise "Expected exactly 1 winner from Draw, got alice=#{a_won} bob=#{b_won}" unless (a_won ^ b_won)
  puts "OK: Draw picked 1 winner live (alice=#{a_won}, bob=#{b_won})!"

  puts "ALL PRODUCTION SMOKE CHECKS PASSED!"
ensure
  browsers.each { |b| b.quit rescue nil }
  if pid
    Process.kill("TERM", pid) rescue nil
    Process.wait(pid) rescue nil
  end
  Dir.glob("storage/production.sqlite3*").each { |f| FileUtils.rm_f(f) }
  FileUtils.rm_f("tmp/prod_smoke.log")
end
RUBY
